SELECT qi.process_id AS "processId", COALESCE(NULLIF(bp.process_name, ''), CONCAT('工序#', qi.process_id), '未关联工序') AS "processName", COUNT(*) AS "inspectionCount", SUM(CASE WHEN qi.result = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "failedCount", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN qi.result = 'F' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.qty), 0) FROM qms_defect d WHERE d.inspection_id = qi.inspection_id) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "defectQty" FROM qms_inspection qi LEFT JOIN pro_work_order wo ON wo.work_order_id = qi.work_order_id LEFT JOIN base_process bp ON bp.process_id = qi.process_id WHERE qi.status = '2' AND qi.inspection_round = 1 AND qi.inspection_time >= #{start} AND qi.inspection_time <= #{end}
GROUP BY qi.process_id, bp.process_name ORDER BY "failedCount" DESC, "defectQty" DESC, "processName" LIMIT 20

SELECT wi.item_id AS "itemId", bi.item_code AS "itemCode", bi.item_name AS "itemName", COALESCE(SUM(wi.qty), 0) AS quantity, COALESCE(SUM(wi.locked_qty), 0) AS "lockedQuantity", bi.unit AS unit FROM wms_inventory wi LEFT JOIN base_item bi ON bi.item_id = wi.item_id
AND 1 = 0
GROUP BY wi.item_id, bi.item_code, bi.item_name, bi.unit ORDER BY quantity ASC, "itemName" LIMIT 50

SELECT aa.alert_id AS "alertId", aa.alert_no AS "alertNo", aa.alert_type AS "alertType", aa.alert_level AS "alertLevel", aa.status AS status, aa.create_time AS "createTime", bwu.unit_name AS "unitName", be.equipment_name AS "equipmentName" FROM andon_alert aa LEFT JOIN base_work_unit bwu ON bwu.unit_id = aa.unit_id LEFT JOIN base_equipment be ON be.equipment_id = aa.equipment_id LEFT JOIN pro_work_order wo ON wo.work_order_id = aa.work_order_id WHERE aa.create_time >= #{start} AND aa.create_time <= #{end}
AND (aa.unit_id IN
#{unitId}
OR wo.work_unit_id IN
#{unitId} )
AND (aa.reporter_user_id = #{userId} OR aa.handler_user_id = #{userId} OR wo.assignee_user_id = #{userId})
ORDER BY aa.status, aa.alert_level DESC, aa.create_time DESC LIMIT 50
